payload.description_html:
Ossified cervical tendon of Sarmientosaurus musacchioi gen. et sp. nov. (MDT-PV 2).

(A) Section of tendon. (B) Field photograph showing relative dispositions of the camellate tissue of a cervical vertebra (hatched arrow), a cervical rib (white arrow) and the cervical tendon (black arrows) upon discovery. (C) Longitudinal thin-section of tendon showing longitudinal structures compatible with fibroblasts (near the top of the thin-section). (D) Transverse thin-section showing Haversian tissue. (E) Longitudinal thin-section (crossed polars, 100×) of tendon of Podilymbus (grebe) showing fibroblasts (modified from Organ and Adams [174]). Abbreviation see text. Scale bars = 5 cm in A; 1 mm in C–D; 0.1 mm in E.
